title: Adic initial ideal and padded homogeneous generator degree sequence
statement:
For a field $k$, a commutative $k$-algebra $A$, submodules $\mathcal A_d\subseteq A$ indexed by $d\in\mathbf N$, and an ideal $C\subseteq A$, put $C_d=\mathcal A_d\cap C$ and
$$\mu_{\mathcal A,C}(d)=\operatorname{finrank}_k\left(C_d/\iota_d^{-1}\left(\sum_{j=1}^{d}\mathcal A_j C_{d-j}\right)\right),$$
where $\iota_d:C_d\hookrightarrow A$ is inclusion, the product is the span of products of elements, and finrank is the natural-number dimension (zero for infinite-dimensional spaces) [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. For any $\mu:\mathbf N\to\mathbf N$ define
$$\Delta_\mu(i)=\inf\{d\in\mathbf N:1\le d,\ i<\sum_{j=1}^d\mu(j)\}\in\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\},\quad i\in\mathbf N,$$
with infimum of the empty set equal to $\infty$. This is the increasing enumeration of positive degrees with their multiplicities, padded by $\infty$ when the cumulative multiplicity is bounded.
For a commutative ring $W$ and ideals $\mathfrak l,\mathfrak c$, use the canonical associated graded ring $G=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}\mathfrak l^d/\mathfrak l^{d+1}$ and its inclusions $\operatorname{in}_d$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. Let $\operatorname{adicGrade}(\mathfrak l,d)$ be the $(W/\mathfrak l)$-span of the image of $\operatorname{in}_d$. Define
$$E_{\mathfrak l}(\mathfrak c)=\left(\operatorname{in}_d(a\bmod\mathfrak l^{d+1}):d\ge0,\ a\in\mathfrak c\cap\mathfrak l^d\right)\subseteq G.$$
For local $W$, take $\mathfrak l$ to be its maximal ideal and $k=W/\mathfrak l$ its residue field [def-weil-residue-field], and define
$$\nu^*(W,\mathfrak c)=\Delta_{\mu_{\operatorname{adicGrade}(\mathfrak l,-),E_{\mathfrak l}(\mathfrak c)}}.$$
These are concrete definitions, with no finiteness or regularity claim; for the regular local applications and $\mathfrak c\subseteq\mathfrak l$ they give the initial ideal and Hironaka's minimal homogeneous generator degree sequence.
